source_name: Open Corporates Albania (QKB commercial register open data)
notes: QKB commercial register republished as open data by Open Data Albania (AIS). Company lists (by year) + per-company pages keyed on NIPT (letter+8digits+letter). Fields: name, NIPT, administrator (personal data), owners (ortakë), capital, activity (objekti), status, former names (ish). Verified: 4,459 NIPTs extracted from one list (NEXUS GROUP L67508702G, etc.).

source_name: QKB — National Business Center (commercial register extract)
notes: The official commercial register. Free per-company extract (ekstrakt) by NIPT/name. Authoritative identity: NIPT, name, legal form, registration date, administrator, owners, capital, activity, address, status. No open bulk (per-company); Open Data Albania mirrors it openly. Financial statements (bilanci) filed here. Directors/owners are personal data.
National open-data portal. May host QKB / business-register datasets; the CKAN-style API was not at the standard path. The practical open company source is opencorporates.al (Open Data Albania).
